externals.rule: model/schema/ declares shapes and imports nothing outside this tree
model/ is pure and imports nothing outside this tree

purity.awaitRule: no await under model/; service/ is where I/O happens
purity.asyncFunctionRule: no async function under model/; model functions are synchronous
purity.newDateRule: no clock read under model/: new Date() is impurity

members.rule: no clock read under model/: Date.now is impurity
no randomness under model/: Math.random is impurity
